provisional_claim_family: The Kasparov product gives a source-qualified bilinear pairing KK(A,D) x KK(D,B) -> KK(A,B), associative and unital under the hypotheses fixed by the selected primary theorem.
domain_and_universes: Open: graded or ungraded, separable and sigma-unital hypotheses, coefficient algebra, and universe levels must follow the selected source and Lean APIs.
quantifiers: Open until a unique primary theorem is selected.
hypotheses: Open; no C*-algebra or Hilbert-module assumptions are silently supplied at intake.
conclusion: Open; the provisional family includes existence/well-definedness of the product and possibly associativity and units, but no package is yet canonical.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not yet fixed; zero algebras, trivially graded algebras, nonunital algebras, and identity objects require source-led treatment.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical choice, quotients, and extensionality requirements not frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository toolchain, and pinned mathlib expected; exact imports and transitive trust closure open
computation_profile: Noncomputable quotient and Hilbert-module constructions expected; no oracle or certificate policy frozen
source_revisions: Repository base revision recorded in validation.md; Lean toolchain and dependency revisions to be fingerprinted at statement phase

owners_and_reviewers.reviewer: independent domain and assurance reviewers not yet assigned

freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on target/source wording, selected theorem, toolchain, dependency, formal expression, or normative-profile change; master records acceptance, review due date, revocation, and incident handling.
